summary: Hiker attempting the unmarked Hell Roaring Ridge route near Capitol Lake set out Sunday and camped in the area; became cliffed out in the morning, unable to proceed up or down; contacted a friend via Garmin inReach, who alerted rescuers; Mountain Rescue Aspen team established contact and determined the hiker could shelter in place; reached by 12 p.m. Monday using GPS coordinates and local knowledge; uninjured and assisted back to the trailhead.
location: Hell Roaring Ridge / Capitol Lake, near Capitol Peak
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen / Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date pinned: article published ~2024-10-03 with story framing "the call came in on Monday morning" after a Sunday set-out → Monday 2024-09-30, weekday-verified. | 2026-09-15 run 617: thenextsummit.org writeup corroborates — MRA located the hiker ~1 mi north of Capitol Lake via GPS ~noon, uninjured, escorted back to Capitol Lake Trailhead by afternoon (URL parent-opened this run).
